description: Capabilities specific to the main file-browser windows: platform information, the system's 12/24-hour clock setting, the trash, the thumbnails plugin's status only (the page asks for thumbnails through the app's own commands, which take no paths), the volumes, the file types and their applications, and the application settings: reading them, and changing only their `ui` part for the Action bar's own choices (View → Action Bar, Hide Labels), never the whole document.
